text:
Marta L: Hey folks — quick sync. I opened a PR to update the SOC2/security docs retention language and add an audit-logs example. Need legal wording review before we merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

Devin K: Thanks — can you paste the new phrasing here?

Marta L: Sure. Current draft snippet in PR: 

```
Data Retention: We retain audit logs and telemetry for 90 days by default to support incident investigations and compliance. Sensitive user content is redacted and not used for model training.
```

Marta L: Also added an example showing how customers can request log exports via the Console API (endpoint link in PR).

Ryan S: Want to suggest a small change: avoid saying "we retain" without clarifying scope. Maybe: "Default retention period for audit logs: 90 days. Customers can request extended retention under an enterprise contract."

Samira (Legal): Quick note: "not used for model training" is good, but please add an explicit exception clause: "except when explicit opt-in is provided by customers and governed by a written agreement."

Devin K: Got it. Updating the copy now. Also — the SDK snippet for log export needs a tiny fix. Current snippet uses old client call. I'll paste the corrected snippet here:

```js
// export audit logs
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const res = await client.logs.export({ from: '2025-06-01', to: '2025-06-30', format: 'json' });
console.log(res.url);
```

Devin K: Should we include the retention policy reference link inline? e.g., "See Retention Policy (link)"

Marta L: Yes, add link to /security/data-retention and the governance note from Samira. Also include a small callout about redaction: "We redact PII by default; customers can provide additional redaction rules."

Samira (Legal): That looks fine. One more thing: please replace "sensitive user content" with "customer content" everywhere — it's clearer legally.

Ryan S: Ack. I also ran a quick check against SOC2 language we used in previous audits — this aligns, just keep the explicit opt-in clause. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: CI: docs/lint passed for PR #412 (3 files changed) :white_check_mark:

Marta L: Thanks — sounds like we have consensus. I'll push an updated commit with wording, the SDK snippet fix, and the retention link. Planning to merge after 24h if no further comments.

Devin K: Thanks all — will monitor the PR thread for any follow-ups.

Samira (Legal): Approved from legal side, pending final commit.

Ryan S: LGTM

Marta L: Merging on +1 after CI — will note the change in the release notes.
